name: Use Case Deck Generator

parameters.content:
## Use Case Deck Generator
**Setup required:**
1. Replace the folder ID placeholder in "Save Deck to GDrive" with your central GDrive folder ID
2. Create an Anthropic API key credential (HTTP Bearer Auth → name it "Anthropic API Key")
3. For manual runs: paste the Notion use case page UUID into "Set Page ID"

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
={{ 'You are the novagentica-use-case-library skill. Analyse the use case data below and return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences, no commentary) matching this schema exactly:
{
  "title": "<use case name>",
  "vertical": "<vertical name e.g. Defence & Aerospace>",
  "slide1": {
    "eyebrow": "<VERTICAL · FUNCTION in caps>",
    "headline": "<declarative sentence, max 60 chars>",
    "subhead": "<short contrasting phrase>",
    "rows": [{"label": "<LABEL IN CAPS>", "body": "<1-2 sentences>", "italic": "<crimson closer or null>"}],
    "tagline": "<runtime and maturity note>"
  },
  "slide2": {
    "eyebrow": "<USE CASE · AGENT ARCHITECTURE>",
    "headline": "<agent name, max 45 chars>",
    "subhead": "<Domain to Outcome to key term>",
    "tiles": [{"num": "1", "title": "<STEP IN CAPS>", "body": "<max 120 chars>"}],
    "tagline": "<target systems>"
  },
  "slide3": {
    "eyebrow": "<THE ECONOMICS · CONCEPT caveat>",
    "headline": "<value figure with period, max 45 chars>",
    "subhead": "<maturity caveat>",
    "stacks": [{"num": "01", "label": "<METRIC IN CAPS>", "text": "<1-2 sentences>", "highlight": true}],
    "tagline": "<runtime, blast radius, MVP phase>"
  }
}

Rules:
- slide1.rows exactly 3: THE GAP, THE CONSEQUENCE, THE UNLOCK. Set italic to null if not needed.
- slide2.tiles exactly 5 agent flow steps.
- slide3.stacks exactly 4: VALUE AT STAKE (highlight true), DEPLOYMENT, REPLICABILITY, BLAST RADIUS.
- slide1 headline max 60 chars. Slides 2 and 3 headlines max 45 chars.
- Maturity rule: never present Modelled as Live. For Concept omit specific monetary values.

Use case data:
' + JSON.stringify($('Fetch Use Case Page').item.json) }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ 'name = \'' + $json.vertical + '\' and mimeType = \'application/vnd.google-apps.folder\' and \'0AMdoTeqWu05eUk9PVA\' in parents and trashed = false' }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ 'name = \'' + $('Prepare Slides Data').item.json.title + '\' and mimeType = \'application/vnd.google-apps.presentation\' and \'' + $json.folderId + '\' in parents and trashed = false' }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ 'name = \'Archive\' and mimeType = \'application/vnd.google-apps.folder\' and \'' + $('Normalize Folder ID').item.json.folderId + '\' in parents and trashed = false' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 4096, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $('Prepare Claude Prompt').item.json.prompt }] } }}

description: Generates a 3-slide use case deck via Claude when a Notion Use Case Library entry is created or updated, saves it to a central Google Drive folder, and attaches the file link back to the Notion record's Deck property.
